ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the collector ingested this record into MAAS

access_date.description: Grafana access timestamp from the Loki log stream 't' field

user.description: User name that accessed Grafana from the Loki log stream 'uname' field

reportName.description: Name of the source Grafana usage report the record was extracted from

interface_name.description: Name of the source Grafana usage interface (e.g. Grafana_Usage_Prod)

dashboard.description: Accessed dashboard path from the Loki log stream 'path' field
